pc.camera.video_failed: The video could not be recorded.
pc.camera.unavailable: The camera could not be opened.
pc.camera.hint: A photo opens in the editor before it is sent. A video is sent when you stop it (one minute at most). On a Mac, the first use asks for camera permission.
pc.markup.title: Edit photo
pc.markup.draw.hint: Drag on the photo to draw.
pc.markup.text.hint: Click where the text goes, type it, then press Enter.
pc.markup.blur.hint: Drag a box over what must not be seen: faces, names, numbers. Blurred areas cannot be recovered from what is sent.
pc.markup.crop.hint: Drag the area to keep. Undo removes the crop.
pc.markup.failed: The edited photo could not be prepared.
